records.source_statement: Lilly quotes an 'Arabick Aphorisme' about Moon between certain zodiac degrees and never returning/marrying after widowhood.
limitations: Explicit marginal note cautions not to credit without concurrence of other significators.

records.source_statement: A further printed Arabic aphorism ties Moon in first twelve degrees of Virgo to possible pre-marital death/disagreement.
limitations: Author says not to overtrust uncorroborated aphorisms; no verified deaths.

records.source_statement: New subsection asks whether man or wife shall die first and at what time.
Compare first and seventh lords for which applies first to combustion: associated spouse is predicted to die first.
limitations: Exact directed comparative prerequisite, not any combust planet.

records.source_statement: First lord retrograde, combust, in fall or near eighth is assigned to man's risk; analogous seventh lord to woman's, with Sun or Venus adverse states added.
limitations: Alternative afflictions, historically gendered not medical.

records.source_statement: First combust significator in tropical sign is assigned shorter interval, common sign longer, fixed longest until alleged death.
limitations: Qualitative speed only; do not invent years or exact dates.
